sources.label: Neri retry
sources.text: Neri stores a result under the pair of account ID and request key. A retry by the same account and key returns the stored result. The same key submitted by another account cannot read that result.

My attempt: reuse the stored result for the same account and key. Can another account use that key to read my result?
